✷12TH CLASS BOARD EXAMS

Endless calls & texting.
Studying & sharing every moment.

Those 12th class days... online preparation, endless calls and texting each other all day long, helping each other, studying together, and sharing every little thing.

☾COLLEGE TO BUS STOP

Walking & laughing together.

Walking from college to the bus stop, talking, laughing, teasing each other, and eating at the bakery about random things — simple, happy moments.

♡COOL MORNING BREEZE

Early morning calls.

Talking on calls in the cool breeze during those early mornings while coming to college... peaceful moments where hours felt like seconds.

02 / A NOTE FROM THE HEART
WITH LOVE
30 DEC

Dear Stella,

I don't know if I can perfectly put everything I feel into words. But when I look back at everything we've shared, I realize how many beautiful memories are connected to you.

The calls, the chats, the laughs, the walks, the bakery moments, the board exam preparation days, and those early morning conversations in the cool breeze while coming to college. All those little moments became memories that I will always carry with me.

Somewhere between all those conversations and memories... you became someone very special to me. Today is yours. Make a wish. Take the bigger slice!

Forever Yours,
With All My Heart ♡
